en: Rookie
$10,000 and no special rules.
Day Trader
$8,000, starts with Low Fees, maximum leverage +1x.
Value Investor
$12,000, cannot short, long dividends are doubled.
Insider Inu
Knows one rumor a quarter is true, and can publish its opposite.
Pre-market (once a quarter, on one random day): you learn that tomorrow's rumor is TRUE.
Market open (once a quarter): FLIP that rumor. Next day: it is published as the opposite, and stamped as planted when it resolves. Nobody learns by whom.
Copilot Cody
Copies another player's bet whenever he likes.
None.
Market open (every day): COPILOT one rival. After-market: you hold the same option as them, at the normal odds.
Double Dan
Sees every bet first, then decides whether to double his own.
None.
After-market (once a quarter): DOUBLE DOWN. When the bets are revealed, double your own option before the result.
Saving Son
Lets the cash work. Simple and steady.
Next day: your cash earns 0.5% interest.
None.
Goldfish Gus
Forgets everything but today. Gets paid for it.
Market open: no credibility tiers and no chart, only today's price. After-market: your options pay +0.3 odds.
None.
Hodl Hana
Never sells. Believes in one stock, loudly.
Pre-market, day 1: half your cash is already in the best stock of the pre-game weeks, bought at its low, and it can never be sold. After-market: options on rumors in its sector pay +0.5 odds.
None.
